description: Skydio publishes a photogrammetric mesh of a crane mast through an Objaverse and Sketchfab-derived Zenodo record. The GLB geometry and JPEG previews are free under CC BY 4.0. The documented capture used 501 photographs acquired on 6 February 2020, with a four-metre camera distance and 1.7-millimetre ground-sampling distance. Bentley ContextCapture reconstructed the surface. This can supply measured asset geometry for visual inspection, collision-scene preparation or synthetic camera observations in infrastructure digital twins. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this crane scan. Coverage is one mast, with its site and crane model unspecified. Ground-sampling distance is a capture property and does not certify geometric accuracy. The mesh units, scale, coordinate frame, completeness and load-bearing properties remain unverified. It should not be used directly as a structural finite-element model. The GLB and source photographs were not downloaded, and reconstruction quality was not independently checked.
